## Projects

### Multi-Class Classification of Chest XRays
Implemented Transfer Learning using the frozen layers of ResNet-18 along with GAN for data augmentation on Kaggle.
URL: https://www.kaggle.com/code/sayanganguly72/chest-xray

### Light Your Diya
A viral interactive map for Diwali, enabling users to place virtual diyas, share messages, and form real-time connection chains using React, Supabase, Leaflet, and OpenStreetMap.
URL: https://light-your-diya.vercel.app/
Tags: React, Supabase, Leaflet, OpenStreetMap

### WhatsApp Wrapped
Wrap your annual WhatsApp memories the same way as Spotify helps you do it.
URL: https://whatwrapped.vercel.app/
